bugs.title: incremental review Git reads use metadata project root instead of authoritative Git root

reproSteps: Run the Git-root cwd contract before 15ee61146e

bugs.title: full-suite liveness aggregate is cyclic and four-worker lower bound exceeds performance budget

evidence.symptom: root npm test printed flow stability PASS but timed out at 120 seconds and the 47-test suite exceeded its 300-second budget
reproSteps: Observe component-to-aggregate recursion and jobs=4 total worker-time lower bound 307.95 seconds
evidence.hypothesis: Cyclic suite composition and insufficient bounded worker capacity are independent causes
evidence.rootCause: Four component smokes called their aggregate, which called the components again; after removing back-edges, 1231.8 worker-seconds still made jobs=4 mathematically unable to meet 300 seconds
evidence.fixEvidence: a2d7c9dbe1 makes the aggregate acyclic, adds structural negative checks, uses a bounded five-worker pool allowed by resource policy, and npm test passes 47/47 in 288.9 seconds with no timeout

bugs.title: F-107 resolution inaccurate: candidate-routing barrier still leaks freshness after unbinding queryFiltering (corpusDigest identical, candidateSpecSetDigest moved); repro stashed at stash@{0}

renderReviewInventoryStatus:204 backfills a missing current-wave lane with the PREVIOUS wave's terminal, so an unsaturated wave displays five 'pass' rows alongside a LANES_INCOMPLETE blocker; this misled the story owner into reporting saturation reached (topology critic F-113)

evaluateReviewInventoryWave (review-inventory-epoch.ts:361) aggregates rawFindings only over epoch.requiredLanes, which excludes lattice-review-topology-critic; the critic's own findings (e.g. F-113, high, open) are therefore invisible to New verified findings and unresolvedFindingIds, so a wave can report saturation while a high-severity critic finding is open. No separate gate requires a valid topology_critic_receipt before review_inventory_finalize either.
